name: Sunset Orchard
description: Sunset Orchard is a pumpkin patch in Richland Center, WI. Visitors come for Raspberries, Apples, Cherries, Pumpkins, and Grapes, best in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Sep in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
